meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网址、设计稿或一段文字变成能发布出去的视频、动画和动效图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有网址、设计稿或文案,想把它做成可直接发布的视频或动效。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a URL, design file, or brief into a publishable video, animation, or motion graphic
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a URL, design, or brief and want a publishable video or motion graphic fast.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 成为视频入口：先读取现有项目状态，信息不足时先问清意图，再选定并安装对应工作流，把活交给领域技能。视频由 HTML 合成渲染，除非你另选框架。
howto.when: 当你要制作、编辑或渲染视频/动画，或处理现有 HyperFrames 项目的检查、发布等操作时接管；输入可以是网址、GitHub PR、Figma 设计等。

howto.what_en: It turns Claude into the video entry point: it reads project state, asks about intent when needed, installs the matching workflow, and routes to domain skills. Output is video rendered from HTML compositions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make, edit, or render a video or animation, or to inspect or publish an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs can be a URL, a GitHub PR, a Figma design, and more.

say_en.text: Turn this URL into a product launch video
Add captions to this talking-head footage, keep the picture
Turn this GitHub PR into an explainer video
